notes.en: Public preview 0.3.0. Adds transfer verification controls, help and an account-deletion request entry, and improves sharing and relay-renewal failure handling. Transfers remain foreground-only. Direct APK distribution; no Google Play, Play Services or Play Billing.
notes.zh: 公开预览版 0.3.0。新增传输验证选项、帮助和账号删除申请入口，改进系统分享及中继续期失败处理。传输仍需保持应用在前台。仅以 APK 直接分发，不在 Google Play 上架，不含 Play 服务或 Play 结算。
